data.body: Consideration: [Dependency gap] The Strata-anticipation fixture's expected golden-master tag set must be specified in S1's DETECTION-SCHEMA.md (e.g., language:ruby, package_manager:bundler, framework:rails, framework:strata-rails, platform:strata) before S3 authors the test. Without a frozen expected value, the fixture becomes a forcing function on the Strata epic (70d5-37ee). If the Strata namespace cannot be settled in S1, mark the Strata fixture as deferred and remove it from S3's golden-master assertions until A2 settles.
